Daily from 06:00. Lows over 4 % in 3 days -> 10 % lower (not under 80 %). Below 100 %, highs over 8 % with few lows -> back up, never above 100 %. More than 100 % is only a hint: you decide.

Rebound guard

Off by default. After a hypo treatment (12 g or less at glucose under 4.5) for 3 hours: no SMB and the temp basal not above the profile basal. Lets go at once when a meal is logged, at glucose 13.9 or more, or early when insulin is really needed: a strong rise over 9, a rise far above what the treatment explains, or a flat high over 10 after 45 minutes. It only takes insulin away: it never gives more, never blocks your bolus. Manual temp basals in these 3 hours are capped too.
Holds now: no SMB, temp basal capped, until %1$s.
